title: MeRT clinic networks continue expanding availability across the U.S.
summary: Private clinic networks offering MeRT (Magnetic e-Resonance Therapy), an individualized EEG-guided form of transcranial magnetic stimulation, continue to open new locations across the U.S., citing demand from families seeking non-drug options for autism. The growth reflects provider-reported demand rather than new independent clinical trial evidence, and families are encouraged to weigh the limited peer-reviewed evidence base before enrolling.

sources.label: Brain Treatment Center - MeRT for Autism
